segments.text: OK so this is the customer search screen. Before we do anything we search by postcode and surname.
segments.speaker: Expert

segments.text: We always search first, otherwise we end up with duplicates.
segments.speaker: Expert

segments.text: If nothing comes up, we press New customer up here.
segments.speaker: Expert

segments.text: This is the details screen. Title, first name, last name, date of birth, email.
segments.speaker: Expert

segments.text: Is the email always filled in?
segments.speaker: Analyst

segments.text: Most of the time we have one. Sometimes not.
segments.speaker: Expert

segments.text: Once everything is filled in we press Save. It checks the email looks right and that they're over eighteen; if not it just won't save.
segments.speaker: Expert

segments.text: Now the identity check. We upload the scan of their passport or driving licence here.
segments.speaker: Expert

segments.text: Then we pick the result, pass or fail, and press Submit.
segments.speaker: Expert

segments.text: That drops them into the approvals queue. Nothing happens until a manager approves.
segments.speaker: Expert

segments.text: Usually Dave does the approvals. If he's off, well, it waits.
segments.speaker: Expert

segments.text: And once it's approved the status changes to Active and that's the customer onboarded.
segments.speaker: Expert
